concerns.text: T020 must write correlation_results.csv conforming to analysis_output.schema.yaml, whose REQUIRED fields include `vif` (per-row VIF values). But VIF is computed by T024, which the stated execution order places AFTER/parallel to T020 ('T018 → (T020, T024 parallel) → T021'). This is a consumer-before-producer violation: T020 cannot fill the required `vif` column until T024's diagnostics exist. Either move T024 before T020, or split T020 so the vif column is populated in a follow-up step after T024.

T021 correctly consumes vif_valid_predictors.json from T024 and is ordered after it — good — but the dependency is only implicit in the execution-order line; add an explicit 'after T024' note to T021's description to prevent an implementer from running it after T020 only.
